forms.active_factor_note: Scaled strong factors equal their discriminants at positive zeros; not all factors are units.

domains.parameters: positive integers; program parameters fixed on valid shifted program slices

fixed_numeral_recipes.production_offset: val(1 e(u without its last b) 10)

fixed_u9_recipe.machine: Neary-Woods U9 Table4 with the sole missing instruction adapted to accept
fixed_u9_recipe.production_offset_definition: val(1 e(u without its last b) 10), e(b)=10^beta1,e(c)=1
fixed_u9_recipe.state_numbering: start first, remaining nonhalt states by repr, halt last
fixed_u9_recipe.u_definition: Interleave the fixed tracks: u[beta*i+j]=track_j[i]. The imported production_letter(table,counts,k) specifies every letter.
